skills.name: Impact Wrench
skills.description: Johnson throws his wrench toward the target location, dealing 120<font color='#47BE34'>( +220% Total Physical Defense)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in its path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8s.

skills.name: Electromagnetic Waves
skills.description:
Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing 80<font color='#27C0C7'>( +60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction and slowing them by 20%. Each instance of damage also increases the enemy's subsequent damage taken from the skill by 15% (up to 45%). This damage is increased by 60% against creeps.
Johnson can cast Basic Attacks and skills for the duration.
skills.tips: As you can continue using basic attacks while this skill is active, you can use basic attacks to adjust this skill's direction, and thus greatly increase its hit rate.

skills.name: Full Throttle
skills.description:
Johnson transforms into a car and begins accelerating over time. An allied hero can use <font color='#404495'>(Hop In)</font> when near Johnson to board the car (only 1 allied hero can ride with Johnson). The car will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or obstacle, dealing 300<font color='#27C0C7'>( +160% Total Magic Power)</font>-450<font color='#27C0C7'>( +280% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5-1s (scales with the car's speed before impact), and creating an electrified zone at the location. The zone continuously deals 60<font color='#27C0C7'>( +20% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> and slows enemies within. While in car state, tap <font color='#404495'>(Brake)</font> to stop immediately or hold <font color='#404495'>(Nitrous)</font> to continuously gain speed for up to 5s. Johnson's location will be revealed to the enemy team for 3s when casting this skill.
<font color='#404495'>(Passive)</font>: Johnson's Physical Defense is increased by 10%.
skills.tips: Take full advantage of Johnson's car form to gank often. You can also carry a teammate with you to steal the enemy's base.

skills.name: Electro Airbag
skills.description: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains a 300<font color='#47BE34'>( +700% Total Physical Defense)</font> shield for 10s. Cooldown: 100s.

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.des: Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Blade Armor
items.des: Unique Passive - Bladed Armor: When struck by a Basic Attack, deals Physical Damage equal to 30% of the incoming damage (calculated before Damage Reduction) plus 20% of the hero's Physical Defense to the attacker and slows them by 15% for 1s.

items.name: Athena's Shield
items.des: Unique Passive - Shield: Upon taking Magic Damage, gains 25% Magic Damage Reduction for 3s (applied before taking damage). Regains this effect 5s after leaving combat.

builds.tips: Tank Build This equipment set is extremely tanky. While Electromag Rays is active, Cursed Helmet's passive effect will also continuously reduce the enemy's HP, resulting in significant overall damage. Along with Oracle's HP regeneration effects and Blade Armor's counterattack mechanism, you'll have the advantage in most skirmishes.
